item.text: The broker currently broadcasts prepared messages without sender context, and the UI’s EventSource cannot set custom headers. type (
	message struct {
		id                  uint32
		event               string
		data                string
		clientUniqueId      string
		username            string
		hasClientUniqueId   bool
		hasUsername         bool
	}
	messageChan chan message
	clientsChan chan client
	client      struct {
		id        string
		address   string
		username  string
		clientUniqueId string
		userAgent string
		diode     *diode
	}
)

func (c client) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s - %s - %s - %s)", c.id, c.username, c.address, c.userAgent, c.clientUniqueId)
}

func (m message) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d %s", m.id, m.event)
}

type broker struct {
	// Events are pushed to this channel by the main events-gathering routine
	publish messageChan

	// New client connections
	subscribing clientsChan

	// Closed client connections
	unsubscribing clientsChan
}

func NewBroker() Broker {
	// Instantiate a broker
	broker := &broker{
		publish:       make(messageChan, 100),
		subscribing:   make(clientsChan, 1),
		unsubscribing: make(clientsChan, 1),
	}

	// Set it running - listening and broadcasting events
	go broker.listen()

	return broker
}

func (b *broker) SendMessage(ctx context.Context, evt Event) {
	msg := b.prepareMessage(ctx, evt)
	log.Trace("Broker received new event", "event", msg)
	b.publish <- msg
}

func (b *broker) prepareMessage(ctx context.Context, event Event) message {
	msg := message{}
	msg.id = atomic.AddUint32(&eventId, 1)
	msg.data = event.Data(event)
	msg.event = event.Name(event)
	msg.clientUniqueId, msg.hasClientUniqueId = request.ClientUniqueIdFrom(ctx)
	msg.username, msg.hasUsername = request.UsernameFrom(ctx)
	if !msg.hasUsername {
		if user, ok := request.UserFrom(ctx); ok {
			msg.username = user.UserName
			msg.hasUsername = true
		}
	}
	return msg
}

func writeEvent(w io.Writer, event message, timeout time.Duration) (err error) {
	flusher, _ := w.(http.Flusher)
	complete := make(chan struct{}, 1)
	go func() {
		_, err = fmt.Fprintf(w, "id: %d\nevent: %s\ndata: %s\n\n", event.id, event.event, event.data)
		// Flush the data immediately instead of buffering it for later.
		flusher.Flush()
		complete <- struct{}{}
	}()
	select {
	case <-complete:
		return
	case <-time.After(timeout):
		return errWriteTimeOut
	}
}

func requestLogger(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		scheme := "http"
		if r.TLS != nil {
			scheme = "https"
		}

		start := time.Now()
		ww := middleware.NewWrapResponseWriter(w, r.ProtoMajor)
		next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)
		status := ww.Status()

		message := fmt.Sprintf("HTTP: %s %s://%s%s", r.Method, scheme, r.Host, r.RequestURI)
		logArgs := []interface{}{
			r.Context(),
			message,
			"remoteAddr", r.RemoteAddr,
			"elapsedTime", time.Since(start),
			"httpStatus", ww.Status(),
			"responseSize", ww.BytesWritten(),
		}
		if log.CurrentLevel() >= log.LevelDebug {
			logArgs = append(logArgs, "userAgent", r.UserAgent())
		}

		switch {
		case status >= 500:
			log.Error(logArgs...)
		case status >= 400:
			log.Warn(logArgs...)
		default:
			log.Debug(logArgs...)
		}
	})
}

func clientUniqueIdMiddleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		clientUniqueId := r.Header.Get(consts.UIClientUniqueIDHeader)
		if clientUniqueId != "" {
			http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
				Name:     clientUniqueIDCookieName,
				Value:    clientUniqueId,
				Path:     "/",
				MaxAge:   consts.CookieExpiry,
				HttpOnly: true,
			})
		} else if cookie, err := r.Cookie(clientUniqueIDCookieName); err == nil {
			clientUniqueId = cookie.Value
		}

		if clientUniqueId != "" {
			ctx := request.WithClientUniqueId(r.Context(), clientUniqueId)
			r = r.WithContext(ctx)
		}
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}

func requestIDLogger(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {

		next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
	})
}

func robotsTXT(fs fs.FS) func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if strings.HasSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/robots.txt") {
				r.URL.Path = "/robots.txt"
				http.FileServer(http.FS(fs)).ServeHTTP(w, r)
			} else {
				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
			}
		})
	}
}

item.text: The request identity now flows through the shared UI fetch client and login request, with the EventSource using the cookie established by its preceding keepalive call. On the server, request events carry sender identity into the broker, while scanner-wide refreshes and keepalives use a background context so they still reach every subscriber. I’m adding focused coverage for the filtering and cookie behavior before compiling.

item.text:
Implemented selective SSE delivery. Request events now reach only other sessions of the same user; background events still reach all subscribers. The UI sends a per-page UUID on its HTTP requests, and the EventSource reuses the HttpOnly cookie established by its keepalive request.

Updated the broker, request context, middleware, scanner and Subsonic event calls, cookie expiry constant, and diode API. Added tests for event filtering and client ID cookie handling.

**Verification:** `go test ./...`, the 41 UI tests, and UI lint passed. The production build could not complete: the repository’s Webpack 4 build fails on Node 20 with `ERR_OSSL_EVP_UNSUPPORTED`.
